title: Vaagri Booli language
description: Unclassified tribal Indo-Aryan language of India
extract: Vaaghri Boli is an unclassified tribal Indo-Aryan language of southern India. It is not closely related to Hindi or Marathi. Hakkipikki, Nakkala, Pittalollu and other local names for the people mean 'bird catchers'.
